about.title: About me
about.intro: I'm a junior frontend developer and career changer focused on Angular, TypeScript and UI/UX design. My thing: bringing creative ideas to life with clean code and learning something new with every project. Through the Developer Akademie and my own web projects, I've built a solid foundation to start my career as a junior developer.
about.location: I’m based in Meitingen (near Augsburg, Bavaria) and am open to remote opportunities and flexible, modern ways of working.
about.curiosity: I love exploring new technologies, especially interactive UI/UX, responsive web design, motion design and scroll-based animations.
about.problemSolving: With tricky bugs, I understand the root cause first, then aim for a clean, minimally invasive solution and bounce ideas off the team—combining creativity, self-reliance, and collaboration in every challenge.
about.portraitAlt: Alica Haunstetter – frontend developer focused on Angular and UI/UX

skills.title: My skills
skills.intro: From HTML, CSS/SCSS and JavaScript to TypeScript, Angular, REST APIs, Firebase and Scrum – this is my toolkit for modern web applications.
skills.outro: Just let me know! If your team works with other technologies, I'll get up to speed quickly and stay flexible.

portfolio.intro: Selected web projects built with Angular, TypeScript and JavaScript. Click around and see my work in action.

projects.join: Kanban task manager built with Angular and Firebase: create and organize tasks via drag and drop, assign users and categories.
projects.wickedWoods: Browser jump-and-run game built with object-oriented JavaScript. Help the little witch survive the wicked woods by collecting potions and fending off dark creatures.
projects.daBubble: Real-time chat app inspired by Slack, built with Angular and Firebase – featuring channels, direct messages and an intuitive interface.

giuliano.text: Alica has an impressive eye for design paired with a genuinely structured approach to coding. She never just settles for a quick fix—she takes the time to understand the root cause and comes up with clean, thoughtful solutions. Her progress and curiosity make her a great asset to any frontend team.

patrick.text: Working with Alica on group projects was always super smooth and motivating. She brings great UI/UX ideas to the table, stays calm when tricky bugs pop up, and communicates clearly so the whole team stays on track.

neelima.text: Coming from C++, I was really impressed by how clean and well-organized Alicas frontend code is. She solves problems well, has a great sense for design, and working through ideas with her always improved our projects. Beyond her technical skills, Alica is a fantastic team player—she is always friendly, approachable, and brings a positive energy that lifts the entire team.
